## The Lamp

I lit a lamp at close of day,
And watched the dark come down like rain,
Across the hills and down the lane,
Until the last of light was gray.

I held the glass and did not pray,
I only sat and watched the pane,
And waited for the night to wane,
And wondered what the dawn would say.

The morning brought a gentle breeze,
And somewhere in the garden grew
A rose that I had never seen;

I walked the paths between the trees,
And all the grass was wet with dew,
And all the world was fresh and green.
